panels.title: Tenant DQ runs / minute by status
panels.description: Phase 240.1.B panel 1 — DQ runs per minute split by status (PASS / FAIL / WARN / UNKNOWN). The DQRunFailureRateHigh alert (>5% over 15m) trips when the FAIL series sustains an unhealthy share. Use the templating ``$engine`` to drill into a specific adapter.

panels.title: Per-engine DQ run duration (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Phase 240.1.B panel 2 — per-engine duration histogram. The DQRunDurationP95Regression alert fires when p95 > 2× the 7d-rolling baseline; this panel is the visual confirmation.

panels.title: DQ score distribution (heat-map by tenant)
panels.description: Phase 240.1.B panel 3 — quality-score distribution heat-map.  Histogram bucketed by ``dq_run_quality_score_bucket`` (the engine-side metric).  A bimodal distribution (lots of 0-0.2 scores AND lots of 0.9-1.0) indicates a tenant whose datasets fall into two distinct quality tiers — usually a sign that the profile mix is wrong for at least one of them.

panels.title: dq-service circuit-breaker state
panels.description: Phase 240.1.B panel 4 — current dq-service client circuit-breaker state.  CLOSED (0) is healthy; HALF_OPEN (1) means recent failure + a probe is in flight; OPEN (2) means queries are short-circuiting to the fallback (status UNKNOWN).  The DQServiceCircuitOpen alert fires when this stays at 2 for 5+ minutes.

panels.title: DQ alert rule firing count by channel
panels.description: Phase 240.1.B panel 5 — DQ alert deliveries per minute split by channel (email / slack / webhook / pagerduty) and status (SUCCESS / FAIL).  The DQAlertDeliveryFailing alert trips when FAIL/total exceeds 10% over 30m; this panel is how oncall confirms it's a real channel failure (versus a routing-config issue).

panels.title: S3 payload-bucket size trend (per tenant)
panels.description: Phase 240.1.B panel 6 — DQ S3 payload bucket size per tenant (gauge populated daily by the ``collect_dq_s3_metrics`` CronJob, 240.1.B.5).  Step-shape is normal (one sample per day).  The DQS3PayloadGrowthAnomaly alert fires when a tenant's series exceeds 2σ above its 7d-rolling baseline — investigate via this panel + the tenant's recent DQ runs.
